body:
Make the board pane interactive (plan §5.2): navigate ticket rows and act on the selected one. Today bin/board.mjs is read-only — it renders via the pure renderBoard() and armInput() only handles quit ('q'/Ctrl-C). This ticket adds keyboard row selection and a focus-pane row-action, keeping ALL decision logic pure and rail-tested; bin/board.mjs stays thin glue.

WHAT TO BUILD

1. Pure selection reducer in a lib (e.g. lib/board-nav.mjs): stepSelection(current, key, rowCount) -> new selected index. Down moves +1, up moves -1, clamped to [0, rowCount-1]; with rowCount 0 it returns a safe sentinel (-1) and never goes out of range. Deterministic and pure (no I/O).

2. Pure row-action resolver: resolveRowAction(selectedTicket, paneRows) -> {kind:'focus-pane', paneId} when the selected ticket id has a mapped pane in the trusted pane map, else {kind:'none', reason}. The paneId comes ONLY from the trusted paneRows map (built by the plugin from herdr pane data) — never from any untrusted string.

3. A fixed-argv builder for the focus action: focusPaneArgs(paneId) -> ['pane','focus', paneId] (herdr argv), so bin/board.mjs runs `herdr pane focus <paneId>` with a fixed argv and the trusted paneId — never a shell string.

4. renderBoard() gains a `selected` parameter (index into the rendered ticket rows). The selected row is visibly marked (e.g. a leading '>' / inverse) and NO other row is; when selected is -1 (nothing selectable) no row is marked. Rendering stays zero-dep ANSI and the existing redraw discipline is unchanged.

5. bin/board.mjs wiring (thin glue): armInput handles Up/Down (arrow escape sequences and j/k) to update the selection via stepSelection and redraw; Enter resolves the row action via resolveRowAction and, on 'focus-pane', runs the fixed herdr focus argv; on 'none' it does nothing (optionally a notification). Quit behavior ('q'/Ctrl-C) is unchanged.

SECURITY (plan §6): the board runs UNSANDBOXED. The only spawned command is `herdr pane focus <paneId>` with a fixed argv and a paneId drawn from the trusted pane map. No repo-local binaries, nothing derived from untrusted ticket content is ever executed, and all rendered strings remain sanitized.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (each has a concrete verification method)

AC1 stepSelection moves and clamps: from 0, up stays 0; from rowCount-1, down stays rowCount-1; down from 0 is 1; up from 2 is 1. VERIFY: unit tests in plugins/adlc-herdr/test/board-actions.test.mjs across the range endpoints.
AC2 stepSelection with rowCount 0 returns -1 and never a valid index. VERIFY: unit test.
AC3 resolveRowAction returns focus-pane + the mapped paneId for a ticket that has a pane. VERIFY: unit test asserting {kind:'focus-pane', paneId}.
AC4 resolveRowAction returns {kind:'none'} for a ticket with NO mapped pane (nothing to focus). VERIFY: unit test.
AC5 focusPaneArgs builds exactly ['pane','focus', paneId]. VERIFY: unit test asserting the argv array.
AC6 renderBoard marks ONLY the selected row: with selected=k exactly one ticket line carries the marker and it is line k; with selected=-1 none do. VERIFY: render test.
AC7 no hollow tests: adlc hollow-test on the changed board libs finds all mutants killed. VERIFY: hollow-test exit 0 (preflight mutation-gate).

RAILS: plugins/adlc-herdr/test/board-actions.test.mjs is frozen once authored — the executable contract for selection, row-action resolution, the focus argv, and the render highlight.
title: herdr plugin: board row-actions (select a ticket row, focus its pane)
